verdict.rationale: Mastercard documents an official Agent Toolkit MCP server that AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor can connect to, and its examples cover Open Finance integration questions. However, the evidence shows it is a platform-wide developer-assistance server for docs Q&A and code generation. It is not shown to give agents operational access to Open Finance accounts, balances or transactions. Missing for 10: Open Finance–specific MCP tools that call live or sandbox APIs, setup and auth details for connecting to the server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: developers using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf) can ask complex questions about Mastercard services and receive contextual, reliable answers pulled straight from the source
